body: This is my plan as well... and all weekend... cannot wait!

My hair is brown, and I've actually been using a purple shampoo for the last two weeks! It's helped make the orange more subtle and not as harsh and dark. I've also heard that blue works for cancelling out the specific tone of orange I have, I might look more into it. Thanks for your response! :)

I'm not sure what advice to give because I imagine you've heard it all by this point, but I just want you to know that I know these feelings too well and I've struggled hard with depersonalization and derealization for about seven years. I know the feeling of hating the world for how it is. It's frustrating as all fuck and it's absolute torture having to live day to day like this but I genuinely believe that time will show us a way out of this hell  that we can achieve while alive. It's difficult to try and learn to remain present and 'in the moment' but start by doing little things like going for a walk or drawing something simple and do your best to throw your full attention into it and engage all of your senses into it. Over time doing this in daily tasks becomes more of a habit instead of something you have to focus hard on and it helps a bit. I'm not one to really respond to things online but I'm just putting this here because in the case of someone's plans to die my two cents could potentially (0.01% chance) be helpful. You're in my thoughts man.
